notes: Sixteen misgendered fields fixed — Zoe is she/her per champ-gender.js. Five of those are report[] entries; they are pronoun-only corrections, not rewrites, so the sweep's two-report-entry limit is not being used up on prose changes. All seven full-layer sides were stale against a content chart that already matched the packet and were aligned to Diana. packet suspectNames flagged 'Use Portal Jump' and 'Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble' — both false positives, those are the real ability names. The missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' rule fires off a trueDamage flag on Sleepy Trouble Bubble, but Riot's text describes a Magic Resist reduction and a doubled wake-up hit, not true damage — I wrote the MR reduction and did not assert true damage. tradeBad left alone.
